note: PCR every 150 ms, then every 600 ms from 60 s (part 7.2). Since B-86 the cadence row judges the PCR against its own cadence: the first 600 ms interval is late under the 150 ms cadence's 500 ms threshold (one crossing, at about 60.5 s), which raises the irregular warning for 60 s and teaches the new cadence; from then the threshold is 1.2 s and nothing is late. Never degraded, locked from 36 s on one epoch, cadence 600 ms at the end. Before B-86: degraded (cadence) at about 62 s, never recovered.
